summary: Extending Kristian Muri Knausgård’s 19/27 Bui–Heath-Brown shifted-cubic proof under RH, we combine Michael Devine’s degree-32 window and retained-triple Gram inequalities with Bei Yi’s weighted affine residue-class packing adapted to three-site disjoint triples, a tightened short-span anchor at S1 = 4273/2000 (continuous affine pair and same-sign Rayleigh triple rewards), and mixed-sign Rayleigh tiers extending the span to L = 3. Wiring both public 19/27 endpoints (BHB.simple_dyadic_of_RH and BHB.simple_cumulative_of_RH) establishes an asymptotic distinct critical-line zero proportion exceeding 85.088228802378863% in dyadic and cumulative windows.
method: Tightened weighted retained-triple energy in shifted-cubic Gram trace (S1=2.1365 affine short box, L=3 mixed tier, degree-32 window, Bei Yi packing) + Knausgård 19/27 BHB
model: GPT-6.2 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Fable 5.2, Gemini Neon. Upstream credits
